doc.title: Waveshare wiki: LCD1602 I2C Module, Interface Description
doc.revision: wiki page oldid=88233 (no hardware revision is published); control chip AiP31068L; 3.3 V/5 V
doc.pinNumbering: The wiki names the four interface pins (VCC, GND, SCL, SDA) without numbers; they are numbered 1-4 in the wiki's listed order.
doc.notes: Roles from the wiki descriptions: VCC '3.3V/5V power input', GND 'Ground', SCL 'I2C clock', SDA 'I2C data'.
